capabilities.factual_basis: The catalog names osv-scanner as an advisory re-check against lockfiles and live advisory databases (AUD/RES units). 86 FR 58205 defines vulnerability disclosure as identifying, reporting, or communicating a vulnerability for remediation, and Note 1 to 4E001.a/.c says those entries do not apply to vulnerability disclosure or cyber incident response. Advisory scanning of this program's own dependencies is that identification activity. NOT-FLAGGED means this unit does not raise it as a publication-gating owner decision under the intrusion-software generation/C2/delivery heading. It is not a license ruling.
